categories.tyre_deg: Tyre Degradation by Compound & Box Window
categories.pace_delta: Lap Pace Delta Tracking & 1s Drop Box Order

clips.title: Radio Check
clips.text: Radio check, Max. Telemetry stream is active, tyres looking good.

clips.title: Traction Down vs Prev Lap
clips.scenario: Exit Traction Down vs Previous Lap
clips.text: Exit traction was down compared to last lap. Modulate the throttle smoother on exit.

clips.title: Wheelspin on Exit
clips.scenario: Rear Slip & Wheelspin on Exit Kerb
clips.text: Noticeable rear slip and wheelspin on exit. Be gentle on the kerbs on throttle application.

clips.title: Stint Traction Loss
clips.text: We are losing exit traction throughout this stint. Rear tyres are overheating, manage throttle.

clips.title: Delayed Throttle Pickup
clips.text: Throttle pickup was delayed on exit. Trust the rear grip and get on power earlier.

clips.title: Soft Deg > 5%
clips.text: Soft tyre degradation is high, over 5 percent per lap. Protect the rear traction.

clips.title: Soft Deg > 10% (Critical)
clips.text: Critical degradation on the Softs, dropping 10 percent a lap. Tyres are falling off a cliff.

clips.title: Medium Deg > 5%
clips.text: Degradation on the Medium is higher than expected, roughly 5 percent a lap. Manage high speed loads.

clips.title: Medium Deg > 10% (Critical)
clips.text: Severe degradation on Mediums, nearly 10 percent a lap. We cannot sustain this stint.

clips.title: Hard Deg > 5%
clips.text: Hard tyre wear is running at 5 percent per lap. We need to nurse them to hit our target lap.

clips.title: Hard Deg > 10% (Critical)
clips.text: Hard tyres are tearing up, 10 percent wear per lap. Prepare for an emergency stop.

clips.title: Inter Deg > 5%
clips.text: The intermediates are wearing over five percent a lap. Use the wet parts of the track to cool them.

clips.title: Inter Deg > 10% (Critical)
clips.text: The intermediates are wearing ten percent a lap. They will not last long like this.

clips.title: Wet Deg > 5%
clips.text: The full wets are wearing over five percent a lap. Keep them in the standing water where you can.

clips.title: Wet Deg > 10% (Critical)
clips.text: The full wets are wearing ten percent a lap. The track may be ready for inters.

clips.title: Box Window Open
clips.text: Box window is open, Max. Standby for the pit call.

clips.title: Box This Lap
clips.text: Box this lap, Max. Box this lap. Confirm we are boxing.

clips.title: Pace Strong (-0.2s)
clips.text: Pace is very strong, delta is negative two tenths. Keep this rhythm.

clips.title: Pace Drop (+0.5s)
clips.text: Pace dropped by roughly half a second compared to last lap. Watch the mid-corner rotation.

clips.title: Pace Drop > 1.0s (Box Order)
clips.scenario: Severe Pace Loss (>1.0s) -> Urgent Box Call
clips.text: Pace has dropped over a full second compared to last lap. Tyres are finished, box this lap for fresh rubber.

clips.title: Pace Drop > 1.2s (Bleeding Time)
clips.text: Delta is plus 1.2 seconds, we are bleeding too much lap time. Box this lap, box this lap.

clips.title: Car Ahead < 1.0s (Overtake)
clips.scenario: Rival Ahead in Overtake Mode Range (<1.0s)
clips.text: Gap to car ahead is under a second. Overtake mode is available, push now.

clips.title: Car Ahead 1.5s
clips.text: Gap to car ahead is roughly 1.5 seconds. You are closing by two tenths a lap.

clips.title: Car Ahead 2.0s
clips.text: Gap to car ahead is 2 seconds. Keep chipping away.

clips.title: Car Ahead 3.0s
clips.text: Gap to car ahead is 3 seconds. Clean air ahead, build the tyre delta.

clips.title: Car Ahead 5.0s
clips.text: Gap to car ahead is 5 seconds. Focus on your own delta.

clips.title: Leader 3.0s
clips.text: Gap to the leader is roughly 3 seconds. Your pace is matching.

clips.title: Leader 5.0s
clips.text: Gap to the leader is 5 seconds. Managing the gap well.

clips.title: Leader 10.0s
clips.text: Gap to the leader is 10 seconds. We are running in clean air.

clips.title: Teammate 2.0s
clips.text: Gap to your teammate is 2 seconds. Maintaining position.

clips.title: Teammate 5.0s Behind
clips.text: Teammate is 5 seconds behind. No pressure from behind.
